description: Manual payments and refunds record the acting user (R0-PL-07). Run from apps/server against a migrated isolated database and REDIS_URL, with dist/main.js built for the journey: npx vitest run test/payments-actor.integration.test.ts test/revenue-authorization.integration.test.ts test/release0-journey.integration.test.ts --no-file-parallelism --reporter=json --outputFile=<report>, then node ../../scripts/proof-admission/evaluate.mjs --manifest ../../scripts/proof-admission/manifests/payments-actor.json --report <report>. Required: every payments-actor case, RA-G5-01 and RA-G5-05 (recordedBy is never public), and the three release0-journey step-4 cases that carry the LEDGER claim and have stable titles (one Payment row and one Payment:<id>:payment_recorded posting per payment, a duplicate submit absorbed, the remainder posted). The rest of the journey belongs to release0-journey.json (R0-16), which retitles the step-4 'FIRST FAILING STEP' case and removes the harness recovery case, so this manifest does not bind those titles; requireReportSuccess still rejects the verdict if any case in the report fails. allowAdditionalCases is true for those journey cases, the two pre-existing revenue-authorization it.todo records (RA-G4-13, RA-G16-01) and the three payments-actor it.todo records PA-16..PA-18. Those three are open gaps found in review, each fixed only outside this packet's write set: a human PATCH of invoice status PAID is attributed to KEY (ST-R011-1), refunding an unposted payment records no refunder (ST-R011-2), and drive-intake approval drops the approver (ST-R011-3). Until they are closed, 'the system actor is distinct from a human' is proven only on the paths PA-06, PA-07 and PA-14 cover.
requiredCases: fixture sanity (real rows) seeded two humans with revenue:write, a system chart of accounts and one SENT invoice per case; the KEY actor id is the shared constant
manual payment through the HTTP route records the acting user PA-01: user U records -> Payment.recordedBy = U (fresh read), posting createdById = U, contact event and activity actorId U
